core_obligations: Take a countable generating set of the given submodule and expand each generator as a finite sum of pure tensors (proof lines 22649-22650).

Let P be the submodule generated by the coefficients appearing in those expansions, which is countable, and observe that the image of P tensor S contains every generator and hence the whole submodule (proof lines 22650-22651).
proof_roadmap: Expand the countably many generators and collect the coefficients (proof lines 22648-22650).
Read off that the image of the resulting submodule contains them all (proof lines 22650-22652).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a countably generated submodule of a base change is contained in the image of a countably generated submodule of the source (statement lines 22640-22646). The proof expands each of countably many generators as a finite sum of pure tensors and takes the submodule generated by the coefficients, which stays countable because each generator contributes only finitely many terms (proof lines 22648-22652). The bookkeeping that keeps the construction countable is exactly what the statement asks for. H2.
